maria (eng-runtime): quick q — where's the canonical place to check p50/p95/p99 for TTFT and tokens/sec per route? seeing a customer spike, need to slice it up :grimacing:
ashwin (eng-platform): use the TTFT dashboard first — panels for p50/p95/p99 by route and model. quick link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ttft/summary (bookmark that one) :bookmark:
jordan (oncall): for tokens/sec look at the tokenflow dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/tokenflow/tokens-by-route — shows tokens/sec and avg tokens/request. filter by customer_id or model_id there. :eyes:
maria (eng-runtime): thanks — are there PromQL examples to pull p95 for a single route? want to add to an adhoc query in a runbook snippet.
ashwin (eng-platform): yup — example (5m window):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_ttft_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le, route))
```
that returns seconds. swap 0.50/0.99 for p50/p99.
lee (eng-sre): and for tokens/sec by route:
```
sum(rate(redwood_tokens_emitted_total{route=~"/v1/.*"}[1m])) by (route)
```
that gives tokens/sec. divide by requests/sec if you want avg tokens/request.
maria (eng-runtime): perfect. any trace examples to jump from the panel to Jaeger/trace sample for a slow TTFT?
jordan (oncall): panels have a sample trace link but you can also use jaeger query with trace tags: service=runtime, operation=generate, tags={"route":"/v1/generate"}. our trace links are anchored from Grafana -> Jaeger.
ashwin (eng-platform): if you don't see traces, make sure debug sampling is on for that tenant; sampling is 0.1 by default. add `X-Debug-Trace: 1` in request to force one.
maria (eng-runtime): will try. Any gotchas when slicing by model_id or cache hits?
lee (eng-sre): yes — prefix cache + KV cache warmups distort early TTFT. Use the `cache_status` label where available (hit/miss) and compare histograms. Also stripe by warmup window (first 30s after deploy) to avoid noise.
ashwin (eng-platform): also remember batching affects tokens/sec and per-request time differently. When traffic is bursty, tokens/sec can look healthy but per-request p95 spikes. look at tokens/sec alongside concurrency and batch size panels.
maria (eng-runtime): alert tuning — we have an existing p95 alert that fired a bunch last night. recommended tweak?
jordan (oncall): if the alert noisy, consider switching to a percentile over a longer window (e.g., p95 over 10m) and add a min-requests threshold to avoid firing on low QPS routes. example alert rule: `WHEN histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(...[10m])) by (route)) > 0.8 AND sum(rate(...requests_total[10m])) by (route) > 5`
lee (eng-sre): for customer-impacting routes use p99 and tie to error rate. for internal infra routes p95 is fine. also add a growth-rate mute for deploy windows.
maria (eng-runtime): sweet. where's the runbook/links canonicalized? want to drop these snippets there.
ashwin (eng-platform): runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OBS/Latency+and+TTFT+Runbook. I added a \"quick queries\" section yesterday.
maria (eng-runtime): thanks — pinging @lee to see if we should change the alert thresholds for the route in question. :thumbsup:
lee (eng-sre): I can take a look — drop the route and a 1h window of anomaly and I'll propose a threshold.
maria (eng-runtime): route is `/v1/generate` for customer corp-42, spike between 02:10-02:45 UTC, p95 jumped from 0.35s -> 1.2s. tokens/sec steady.
lee (eng-sre): that pattern screams queuing/batching. can you grab a few request ids and a trace id? if not, I'll pull histograms and threadpool stats for that period.
maria (eng-runtime): grabbing request ids now. will paste minimal logs here when I have them.
obs-bot: reminder — there is a weekly obs office hours tomorrow 16:00 UTC, bring slices you'd like help with: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/obs-office-hours
maria (eng-runtime): awesome, I'll bring this slice. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
